title: Papyrus ships a neutral public theme and two example themes
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-1be843.

Factor the useful parts of the Machines on Machines design (cards, layout preset, tokens at final sizes) into core as the default theme. A site with only a name looks finished; a brand pack of tokens restyles it; a brand pack cannot carry code. Pulls forward PPY-31efef, PPY-3aa10f, PPY-e572de, PPY-0f4e10 and PPY-2a44b2. Machines on Machines must look the same afterwards.
